Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get domain runtime tree root

items.docs: Returns the root resource of the domain runtime MBean tree, providing links to runtime monitoring data and lifecycle operations across all servers in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all server lifecycle runtimes

items.docs: Returns lifecycle runtime information for all servers in the domain, including current state and available lifecycle operations.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get a server lifecycle runtime

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Returns lifecycle runtime information for a specific server including its current state.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all server runtimes in the domain

items.docs: Returns runtime information for all running servers in the domain, accessed from the administration server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get a server runtime from the domain

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Returns runtime information for a specific server in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List deployment progress objects

items.docs: Returns information about in-progress and completed deployment operations across the domain.
